import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12
    for cls, dim in [(ColumnParallelLinear,0),(RowParallelLinear,1)]:
        mw=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,I,requires_grad=True)
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data.copy_(mw); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        m=cls(I,O,True,mw.clone())
        y=m(x); yr=ref(x)
        assert torch.allclose(y,yr,atol=1e-5)
        g=torch.randn_like(yr)
        (y*g).sum().backward(); gx=x.grad.clone(); x.grad=None
        (yr*g).sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(gx,x.grad,atol=1e-5)
        n = (O if dim==0 else I)//ws
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad.narrow(dim,rank*n,n),atol=1e-5)
        bg = ref.bias.grad.narrow(0,rank*n,n) if dim==0 else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,bg,atol=1e-5)
    if rank==0: print('ok',ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]):
        mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29500+i),nprocs=ws)
